constraints.definition: CHECK ((((vat_state = 'exists'::text) AND (vat_base > (0)::numeric) AND (vat_rate >= (0)::numeric) AND (vat_rate <= (100)::numeric) AND (vat_amount = round(((vat_base * vat_rate) / (100)::numeric), 2)) AND (num_nonnulls(vat_base, vat_rate, vat_amount) = 3)) OR ((vat_state <> 'exists'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(vat_base, vat_rate, vat_amount) = 0))))

constraints.name: finance_expense_tax_reviews_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((wht_state = 'withhold'::text) AND (wht_base > (0)::numeric) AND (wht_rate > (0)::numeric) AND (wht_rate < (100)::numeric) AND (wht_amount = round(((wht_base * wht_rate) / (100)::numeric), 2)) AND (num_nonnulls(wht_base, wht_rate, wht_amount) = 3)) OR ((wht_state <> 'withhold'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(wht_base, wht_rate, wht_amount) = 0))))

triggers.name: expense_no_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER expense_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.finance_treasury_authority_audit FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION expense_immutable()

view.definition:
SELECT a.kind,
    a.account_id,
    a.bank_account_id,
    a.cash_location_id,
    a.name_th,
    a.name_en,
    a.bank_name,
    a.account_number,
    a.is_active,
    b.currency,
    b.opening_id,
    b.opening_as_of,
    b.opening_amount::numeric(14,2) AS opening_amount,
    b.system_balance,
    b.inflow,
    b.outflow
   FROM finance_treasury_accounts a
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL expense_account_balance(a.bank_account_id, a.cash_location_id) b(currency, opening_id, opening_as_of, opening_amount, system_balance, inflow, outflow);
